definitions.explanation: The crime of damaging or destroying something that belongs to someone else, such as breaking a window or scratching a car. Heard mostly in police and news reports, as in {器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}の{疑|うたが}いで{逮捕|たいほ}.

examples.japanese: {器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧。
{器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害届|ひがいとどけ}→被害届：15706_higaitodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I reported the property damage to the police.

examples.japanese: {駐車中|ちゅうしゃちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけた⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A man who scratched a parked car was arrested on suspicion of criminal damage.

notes:
{器物|きぶつ} (articles, things) + ⟦{損壊|そんかい}→損壊：33186_sonkai⟧ (damage). A legal term; the full name of the offence is {器物損壊罪|きぶつそんかいざい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {器物損壊|きぶつそんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to arrest on suspicion of criminal damage
- {器物損壊罪|きぶつそんかいざい}: the offence of criminal damage
- {建造物損壊|けんぞうぶつそんかい}: damage to a building (a separate, heavier offence)
